name: Network Protocol Engineer
description: Build TCP/UDP clients and servers, HTTP handlers, and custom protocol implementations. Understand sockets, packet structures, and network security basics.
deliverables: TCP echo server with concurrent connections
example_snippet:
program TCPServer:
    import from C the action socket takes whole number, whole number, whole number produces whole number as create_socket
    import from C the action bind takes whole number, handle to bytes, whole number produces whole number as bind_socket
    import from C the action listen takes whole number, whole number produces whole number as start_listening

    keep Sock as whole number
    put call create_socket with 2 and 1 and 0 into Sock
    print the text "Server socket created: " and Sock and newline
    call start_listening with Sock and 5
    print the text "Listening on port 8080..." and newline
end program
status_note: dictum_net.c fully implemented (TCP/UDP POSIX sockets). WiFi/BLE/LoRa require niche hardware libs.
